name: United Kingdom
notice: For training only. Simplified from the UK regime and not legal advice.

labels.fiu: UK Financial Intelligence Unit at the National Crime Agency

info.what: An internal report to the firm's MLRO, who decides whether a SAR is made.
info.when: Select it when your review leaves you with knowledge or suspicion.
info.mistake: Delaying the internal report until the suspicion has been proved.

info.what: A report sent to the UKFIU through the NCA SAR Portal.
info.when: Select it when the case should be disclosed to the NCA and no defence is being requested.
info.mistake: Writing a report that gives the facts but not the reason for suspicion.

info.what: A SAR that requests a defence before the firm carries out an act involving suspected criminal property.
info.when: Select it when the firm needs to deal with the property and doing so could be a principal offence.
info.mistake: Treating a DAML as approval of the customer or as a replacement for the firm's own risk assessment.

info.what: The body that supervises the firm's compliance, such as the FCA.
info.when: Select it for matters about the firm's regulatory obligations.
info.mistake: Assuming that a supervisor and the UKFIU have the same role.

info.what: Direct contact with the police, under the firm's procedures.
info.when: Select it when a crime in progress or an immediate risk to someone needs urgent action.
info.mistake: Assuming that a SAR is the way to report an immediate risk.

routes.label: Inform the customer

info.what: Telling the customer about the review or what has been decided about it.
info.when: Consider it only where the law and your firm's procedures allow it.
info.mistake: Not thinking about what the conversation could reveal.

routes.debrief: Telling a customer that a disclosure has been made can be the offence of tipping off under section 333A of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002.

sections.label: Escalation note
sections.help: State briefly what you saw and why it needs further review.

sections.label: Summary of activity
sections.help: Choose the text that states the facts: who, what, where and when.

sections.label: Reason for suspicion
sections.help: Choose the text that explains why the facts are suspicious.

sections.label: Action taken
sections.help: Choose the text that records what was done.

sections.label: Defence requested
sections.help: Choose the text that describes the proposed act, if a defence is needed.
